rationale: Introduce a pin_count_weighted_wl term modulated by a sigmoid transform of pin_density_pnorm to incorporate pin-access pressure influence on high-fanout net wirelength. This provides a meaningful routing-related mechanism beyond wirelength and density alone, encouraging placement that balances wirelength with local pin congestion effects, potentially improving downstream routed PPA. Calibrated coefficients for Tier-2 search: route=3e-07, density=None, wirelength=None.
